Exploitability Assessment: High - These vulnerabilities are well-documented and can be easily exploited by attackers.
Business Impact: Critical - Potential for data breaches, account takeovers, and reputational damage. Could lead to loss of customer trust and legal liabilities.
Prioritized Findings: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
Remediation Priority: Fix vulnerabilities that directly impact security controls, such as missing headers and anti-CSRF tokens.
Remediation Order: Implement Content Security Policy (CSP) header to mitigate XSS attacks.
Add Anti-CSRF Tokens to prevent state changes via forged requests.
Ensure all cookies have the SameSite attribute set to restrict cross-site access.
Configure Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy and Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy headers for additional security.
